milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the glass panes at the building entrance and face them, confirming they have visually located the glass panes. Target is the center of the glass pane cluster at (6.5, 1.5, 5) spawn-relative, with max_distance=5 to require intentional approach from spawn and facing_tolerance=60 to ensure the player is looking at them.

Uses inventory_has because mining gravel causes the block to drop as an item into the player's inventory. With 4 gravel blocks available and only a 10% chance per block to drop flint instead, the probability of getting zero gravel from 4 blocks is 0.0001 (negligible). The mined gravel item ends up in inventory, making inventory_has the most direct check.

Uses inventory_has because crafting light_gray_stained_glass (8 glass + 1 light_gray_dye in crafting table) produces 8 light_gray_stained_glass items that go directly into the player's inventory. Checking for min_count=1 is sufficient since the recipe always yields 8, and the item is not in the starting inventory.
